description: Profiles are sorted by date, lat, lon within each marine region (Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal) and sampled at uniform index stride (stride = N_region // 12), yielding 12 cases per region across the 50-day holdout.
deterministic_seed: no seed used (deterministic index striding over sorted profiles)
selection_basis: Strictly chronological and regional ordering of real physical inversion profiles; zero dependence on model accuracy, error magnitude, visual appearance, or ARGO agreement
